US weekly initial jobless claims come in at 197,000 as it hits the hot list｜Fewer layoffs doesn’t necessarily mean stronger hiring｜ETH around 2,697—I'll wait for the Non-Farm

My stance is that even after the data comes out, I won’t chase a direction. The accurate topic rising on Binance Square is #USWeeklyJoblessClaimsFallTo197000; this time it’s a firsthand report from the U.S. Department of Labor you can verify, so there’s no need to rely only on the hot list. The Department of Labor reported on October 1: for the week ending September 26, seasonally adjusted initial claims for unemployment insurance were 197,000, down by 1,000 from the previously revised 198,000; the four-week average was 200,000, down by 2,500 from the prior revised figure. Continuing claims for the week ending September 19 were 1.701 million, down by 110,000 from the previously revised 1.712 million. Note that initial and continuing claims are reported for different weeks, and the prior values were also revised—so you can’t simply add the two series together.

For the crypto market, what matters most is not the “down by 1,000” direction, but how the labor market affects rate expectations. Lower initial claims often mean firms aren’t cutting jobs at large scale, which may reduce the market’s bets on imminent easing; but initial claims reflect applications for unemployment insurance, not new hires, and they can’t prove that wage pressure is accelerating. ETH has no bond coupon; if the cost of capital stays high, it can suppress valuations for parts of risk assets. On the other hand, if employment resilience supports economic growth, it may improve risk appetite. This is two-way transmission—so you can’t write 197,000 as “ETH must fall” or “ETH must rise.” The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics plans to release the September employment report at 8:30 a.m. ET on October 2; Beijing time is 8:30 p.m. on October 2. That’s when you’ll get a more complete puzzle—non-farm payrolls, unemployment rate, and more. Nothing has been published yet.

The current price reaction isn’t very pronounced. When I was writing, Binance ETH/USDT was around 2,697.32, about -0.05% over the past 24 hours, with a range from 2,667.94 to 2,722.00, and close to the 24-hour open of 2,698.79. This kind of basically flat behavior isn’t enough to prove the market has already priced the claims data into a one-way move, nor can all intraday swings be attributed to macro news. I’m watching the top at 2,722 and the bottom at 2,668: if before the employment data is released neither side effectively breaks through, it looks more like waiting. If price first breaks below 2,668 and the retest can’t reclaim it, a cautious assessment would turn into a stronger defensive bias. If rate expectations cool and price holds above 2,722, then that would be evidence invalidating my earlier wait-and-see judgment.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t enter now—directional waiting, position size 0%. Only if there’s an hourly close above 2,722 and a pullback to 2,712–2,722 that holds, and BTC doesn’t simultaneously dump sharply, I would use up to 0.75% of total funds to take a spot long. First target 2,750 (taking half off), second target 2,780 (closing the remaining position). After entry, if there’s an hourly close back below 2,705, I’ll cut half; hard stop at 2,690 and close everything. If price first breaks 2,668 or if the spread around the time of the Non-Farm release becomes abnormally wide, I’ll cancel this plan and stay in cash with no position. No high leverage, and I won’t try to guess tomorrow night’s official Non-Farm outcome just from one weekly initial claims number.

Source: U.S. Department of Labor Oct 1 Unemployment Insurance Weekly Report; U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics employment report schedule; Binance ETH/USDT real-time quotes.#USWeeklyJoblessClaimsFallTo197000 #ETH

title: 3个问题看清DeFi真假，你的钱包自己管就够了吗？
subTitle:
你是不是也把“资产上链、能连钱包”直接当成DeFi？真正容易踩坑的地方是：非托管只是起点，不代表平台无法干预你的交易。

判断一个项目有多“去中心化”，不用先研究一堆术语，直接问三个问题。

1. 资产到底由谁控制？

如果币要先转进平台，由平台或第三方保管，你拿到的只是平台记账凭证，那它本质上仍属于CeFi。传统银行、中心化交易所都是这类结构。

只有资产由你通过私钥控制，才算迈进DeFi。但别急，这只是必要条件。

2. 有没有人能单独阻止交易？

看看管理员、公司或其他单一主体，能否冻结账户、限制提款，或者阻止兑换和借贷。

如果答案是“能”，说明它可能使用了链上结算，但交易入口仍有明显的中心化控制点。对你来说，这意味着“交易上链”不等于“谁都拦不住”。

3. 有没有人能暂停整个协议？

这是最容易被忽略的一层。核心团队或基金会能否单方面暂停合约、升级逻辑、修改关键参数？如果能，它可以是非托管的，也可以让交易在链上完成，但治理权依然高度集中。

按这三个问题，可以从CeFi、中介接入DeFi结算、中心化治理的DeFi，一直分到完全DeFi。原素材认为，真正达到最后一层的项目极少，$BTC 和 $ETH 可能更接近这一标准，因为目前很难由某个单一个体左右其共识机制。

所以，看盘和交易前别只盯价格与收益率，也要查清资产托管方式、冻结权限和合约暂停权。项目页面写着DeFi，不代表你面对的就是同一种风险。

下次研究项目时，先把这三个问题写在备忘录里，再决定是否参与。

Do you also take “putting assets on-chain and being able to connect a wallet” as DeFi? The place that’s easiest to trip over is: non-custody is just the starting point, and it doesn’t mean the platform can’t interfere with your transactions.

To judge how “decentralized” a project really is, don’t study a bunch of terms first—just ask three questions.

1. Who actually controls the assets?

If the coins must be transferred into the platform first, and the platform or a third party holds them, then what you receive is only the platform’s bookkeeping records—essentially, they still belong to CeFi. Traditional banks and centralized exchanges are structures like this.

Only when the assets are controlled by you through your private key does it count as entering DeFi. But hold on—this is just a necessary condition.

Why do contract fees cost more for some people and less for others? Actually, it’s just one action

First, the conclusion: instant execution = taking orders, fee 0.05%; placing limit orders further away from the current price and slowly queuing for a fill only costs 0.02%. Going back and forth is over twice as much.

Many people think that choosing a limit order means just “placing” an order in the book—but not necessarily. For example, if the current price is 100,000, and you place a buy order at 100,0001 thousand, the system will immediately match and take the existing orders on the order book to execute the trade. It’s nominally a limit order, but in practice you’re charged the take-order fee of 0.05%.

To get the lower fee rate, there’s just one sentence: for buy orders, set the price lower than the current price; for sell orders, set it higher than the current price, and be patient while waiting in the queue. If you frequently enter and exit at market price, the yearly trading fees are enough to buy quite a few lots.

The healthcare technology company Evernorth, supported by Ripple investments, is set to list on Nasdaq. What’s special about this listing is that it will become the largest official reserve custody in XRP’s history, holding XRP worth about $316 million. After the news broke, XRP briefly rose, but then kept falling—showing that the market is taking a long time to digest this “dual identity” logic.

Why is this news important?
Evernorth’s Nasdaq listing is essentially a spotlight moment for XRP’s real-world application to finally take shape. It forcibly moves XRP from “cryptocurrency” to the position of a “mainstream financial partner,” aligning with Ripple’s years-long “compliance is the way to win” strategy. The $316 million reserve is the key number—equivalent to about 1.5% of XRP’s total circulating supply (based on the current market price), far exceeding the holdings of any previous institution or project backer. This means XRP’s compliance-related attributes are being certified in one fell swoop; in theory, it could unlock more institutional funding.

Market impact
It doesn’t meaningfully affect BTC and ETH. These two brothers have recently been stealing the spotlight with AI computing power, and they’ve shown a muted reaction to this indirect XRP positive catalyst. For XRP itself, it’s a line of demarcation between bullish and bearish sentiment: on one hand, this is Ripple’s strongest “institutional empowerment” narrative and should, in theory, support the coin’s price; on the other hand, XRP has been in a downtrend with three consecutive days of limit-down, with extremely bearish technicals—this kind of positive news just isn’t enough to reach and break the downward trend line.

A historical reference is 2019, when Bitfinex became one of the top ten XRP holders. But that time, the price surged 300% within six months. Today’s XRP market size and the current drawdown are completely different.

ETHB’s fee rate isn’t the same thing as staking net returns｜Two layers of fee denominators differ｜Around ETH at 2707 I’ll wait

My stance is: Ethereum staking funds can broaden how institutions participate, but you can’t just infer that ETH will immediately get new buy pressure based on the three words “low fee rate.” I checked the product page for BlackRock’s iShares ETHB: the fund’s standard sponsor fee is 0.25% of net assets; starting March 12, 2026, for the first 12 months, there’s a staged fee waiver on the first $2.5 billion of assets, with the relevant fee rate at 0.12%. Any portion beyond that asset size still applies 0.25%. This isn’t “0.12% on all assets forever,” and it’s certainly not a fund that guarantees an annualized return.

Another commonly confusing figure comes from the prospectus supplement: the fund sponsor, execution agent, and others collectively take 10% from the “total staking rewards,” and the fund keeps the remainder. Later pages of the PDF still show the original 18% from the base prospectus, but the supplement terms clearly replace the old paragraph—when reading, you should first look at the updated text that takes effect. 0.12% or 0.25% is the sponsor fee calculated on the fund’s net assets; 10% is a split on the actual staking rewards generated. These have different denominators, so you can’t just add them to get 10.12% or treat it as investors’ net return. Staking also comes with risks such as validator performance, custody, exit queue delays, and regulatory changes—and the reward amount isn’t guaranteed.

Why is this worth tracking for traders? If an ETF holds and stakes part of its ETH, it may change the cost and return structure for how traditional accounts gain exposure to Ethereum. But choosing one product is not the same as the spot exchange instantly seeing an equivalent net buy order. You have to look at subscription/redemption flows and custody position changes to understand fund flows. Price is also affected by BTC direction, USD liquidity, and on-chain activity. Farside currently shows that as of September 30, the aggregate ETH fund data was a net outflow of about $59.6 million; the ETHB column for that day displays zero. This is just existing daily reporting and may be revised—so you can’t claim that institutions completely exited today based on it, nor can you treat fee discounts as inflows.

At the time of writing, Binance’s ETH/USDT is around $2706.82, with a 24-hour high of $2738.51 and a low of $2667.94—slightly up versus 24 hours ago. It’s still within its range, and there hasn’t been a breakout that can be attributed solely to ETHB’s fee terms. I’m treating $2738 as the upper boundary and $2668 as the lower boundary; if the market is just lively because of news headlines but the price/volume can’t cooperate, the market will eventually overturn that conclusion.

If I were trading it myself: I would not participate right now—neutral on direction, with a position size of zero. Only if ETH closes above $2740 for one hour, then retests without losing support, and BTC does not break below its intraday support at that time, would I consider going long spot. The maximum position would be 2% of total capital. The first target is $2780; once hit, I’d cut the position by half. The second target is $2820; any remaining position would use a moving take-profit. If after entry price falls back below $2715, I’d stop out and close the trade—there’s no need to use “staking returns” as a reason to hold through. If price breaks below $2668 first, the entire long setup is invalid and I’ll wait for a new structure to form. My priority will always be confirmed capital flows and price action—not invent a short-term story from fund fee provisions.

Source: iShares ETHB product page and prospectus supplement; Farside ETH fund daily report; Binance ETH/USDT行情. #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETHB优惠费率不是质押净收益｜两层费用分母不同｜ETH在2707附近我先等

我的态度是：以太坊质押基金能扩大机构参与方式，但不能只看“低费率”三个字就推断ETH马上有新买盘。查了贝莱德iShares的ETHB产品页，基金常规赞助费率为净资产的0.25%；从2026年3月12日起前12个月，对前25亿美元资产实行阶段性减免，相关部分费率为0.12%，超过该资产规模的部分仍适用0.25%。这不是所有资产、永久统一收0.12%，更不是基金保底年化收益。

另一个容易混淆的数字来自招募书补充文件：基金赞助方与执行代理等从“总质押奖励”中合计取得10%，基金保留剩余奖励。PDF后面仍能看到原基础招募书写的18%，但前面的补充条款明确替换旧段落，阅读时要先看生效的更新文本。0.12%或0.25%是按基金净资产计算的赞助费；10%是对实际产生的质押奖励进行分成，两个分母不同，不能简单相加成10.12%或当作投资者净回报。质押还存在验证者、托管、退出排队和监管变化风险，奖励金额也不保证。

为什么这值得交易员跟踪？ETF持有并质押一部分ETH，可能改变传统账户获得以太坊敞口的成本与收益结构；但投资者选择一只产品，和交易所现货立刻出现等额净买单不是同一回事。资金流要看申购赎回与托管持仓变化，价格还受BTC方向、美元流动性及链上活动影响。Farside目前9月30日ETH基金汇总为净流出约5960万美元，ETHB该日栏显示零；这只是既有日报且可能修订，不能据此宣称今天机构完全撤离，也不能把费率优惠算成流入。

撰稿时币安ETH/USDT约2706.82美元，24小时高2738.51、低2667.94，较24小时前小幅上涨。它仍在区间内，没有出现可以单独归因于ETHB费率条款的突破。我把2738附近当上沿，2668附近当下沿；若市场只是新闻标题热闹、量价却无法配合，判断会被现实推翻。

如果是我自己交易：当前不参与，方向中性，仓位零。只有ETH一小时收盘突破2740美元，并回踩不失守，同时BTC不跌破其当时日内支撑，我才考虑现货做多，仓位最多总资金的2%。第一目标看2780美元，触及后减半；第二目标看2820美元，剩余仓位用移动止盈。若入场后重新跌回2715美元下方就止损平仓，不用“质押收益”当扛单理由。若先跌破2668美元，整套多头计划作废，等待重新形成结构。我的优先级永远是验证资金与价格，而不是拿基金条款给短线行情编故事。

MetaMask exits Lido validator nodes after security incident! ETH staking safety once again in focus

After encountering an infrastructure security incident, MetaMask announced preventive measures:
- Exiting affected Ethereum validator nodes.

These validator nodes previously participated in ETH staking via the Lido protocol. Lido stated that the relevant validator nodes operated by MetaMask Staking have already begun the exit process, which is expected to be completed no later than October 7.

However, there’s one key point:
There is currently no evidence that MetaMask wallet users’ assets are directly at risk.
MetaMask said this incident affects part of the infrastructure, and in its non-custodial staking business, users’ withdrawal keys are not managed by MetaMask.

Why is this worth paying attention to?
① Validator node security becomes the focus
ETH staking depends on validators running. If there is a risk to node infrastructure, operators typically choose to proactively exit to reduce potential impact.

② Exiting brings opportunity costs
Lido reminded that during the exit period of the affected validators, some staking rewards may be lost, and penalties related to downtime may also occur.

③ Once again highlights the importance of decentralized infrastructure

In the past, the market focused more on:
- Wallet security
- Private key security
- Exchange security

But as the scale of ETH staking grows, the security capabilities of node operators are becoming increasingly important.
This incident is not about user assets being stolen; it’s a proactive defense against infrastructure risk.

Next, what the market will watch:
👉 Results of the MetaMask security incident investigation
👉 Exit progress of the affected validator nodes
👉 How the ETH staking ecosystem can further raise security standards

In one sentence:
Crypto security is not only about protecting assets in your wallet—it also includes the infrastructure that supports the entire network.

title: ♾️ Infinity Grid: Cómo capitalizar un Bull Run sin techo y sin vender tu inventario
subTitle:
En un mercado francamente alcista (Bull Run), la mayor desventaja del Spot Grid tradicional es que, al alcanzar el límite superior preestablecido, el bot vende todo el activo asignado a USDT y queda fuera del movimiento ascendente.
El Infinity Grid (Grilla Infinita) resuelve este problema eliminando por completo el límite superior. Su algoritmo asegura que el valor total en USDT de tu posición crezca proporcionalmente con el precio, vendiendo solo las fracciones necesarias para mantener constante el valor de la base del activo.
1. La Matemática detrás del Infinity Grid
A diferencia de las grillas fijas basadas en rangos de precios:
Mantenimiento del Valor Base: Si inicias una posición con $1,000$ USDT en $BTC$, el bot ajusta continuamente las órdenes para que el valor de tu tenencia principal no cambie en términos relativos, ejecutando Take Profits porcentuales diminutos en cada nuevo máximo.Sin Límite Superior: Mientras el mercado continúe subiendo, el bot seguirá tomando ganancias en USDT de forma continua e ilimitada.
2. Spot Grid Tradicional vs. Infinity Grid
Spot Grid Tradicional: Diseñado para rangos laterales definidos con soporte y resistencia consolidados. Se detiene al romper la resistencia clave.Infinity Grid: Ideal para activos en fase de descubrimiento de precios (Price Discovery) o en tendencias alcistas estructurales de largo plazo, donde fijar un techo limita la rentabilidad.
3. Consejo Táctico Express (Cómo configurar el Porcentaje por Grilla)
💡 El "Tip" Infinito: Al configurar tu Infinity Grid en Binance, establece el Beneficio por Grilla entre 0.5% y 1.2%. Dado que esta estrategia está pensada para sostenerse durante semanas o meses en tendencias alcistas, un porcentaje por grilla ligeramente más amplio permite capturar movimientos más limpios y maximizar el beneficio neto libre de comisiones de la plataforma.

【Citi Raises Its Target, but the Market Isn’t Chasing: First Look for a Breakout, Then Believe the Narrative】

On October 1, Citi raised its 12-month target to:

• $BTC: 82,000 → 113,000 USD
• $ETH: 2,240 → 3,028 USD

The rationale includes a rebound in crypto market activity, an improved macro environment, and renewed ETF fund inflows. In the coming 12 months, it estimates inflows of about $5 billion.

But the price reaction has been rather restrained. Binance data updated at 19:08 (Taipei time) shows BTC at about $83,866, up only 0.24% over the past 24 hours; ETH at about $2,698, up 0.47%.

On an implied basis, Citi’s nominal upside versus the current price is roughly 35% for BTC and 12% for ETH. However, an “analyst target price” is not an immediate buy signal. Especially since BTC and ETH have already rebounded nearly 40% and 68%, respectively, over the past three months; this raise may simply be institutional acknowledgment of an existing trend.

Next, watch for two sets of price confirmations:

🔸 BTC
If it can hold above the 24-hour high near $85,600 with volume, only then does the institutional narrative have a chance to translate into a new trend. If it breaks below the low near $83,100, it means the news failed to attract follow-through, and the move should still be treated as range-bound.

🔹 ETH
First, see whether it can reclaim and hold $2,737. Only if that succeeds is there a condition to retest the $3,000 psychological level. If it loses $2,667, short-term momentum will clearly cool off.

What truly matters isn’t how high an investment bank writes its numbers, but whether ETF inflows can remain sustained, whether price can break out, and whether the U.S. dollar and bond yields cooperate. A target price is a scenario—not a guarantee.

title: ETH 2700 成了“绞肉机”，为什么大资金专盯急躁的散户？
subTitle:
眼下以太坊正卡在2700这个不上不下的中间价位。
大资金目前就在2626到2750这个宽敞的箱体里来回搓揉洗盘。 很多散户在这个位置急得跳脚，生怕错过主升浪或者大暴跌。
我目前的判断很简单：这里没有单边行情，中间价位全是绞肉机。 在这个不上不下的地方开枪，纯粹是给庄家送过路费。

前阵子，我找人约了个钢琴老师。
我是个理性选手，我知道任何一门学科，入门都需要三年，想稍微有点起色怎么也要五年打底。 我就想弄明白，如果按五年的长线规划，我该怎么分配时间？
女老师一开始挺警惕，估计在想我这个“油腻大叔”是不是想泡她，毕竟在她那个圈子，遇到的大多是玩票的。 她跟我交了底，说以前在苏州待过，有传媒公司老板高薪聘她，专门给女主播做培训。 
要求极其简单粗暴：一两个月内，必须教会女主播弹几首曲子。然后让这些姑娘穿得少一点，坐在镜头前直播。 女老师当时都凌乱了，觉得这些老板脑子有病。一两个月怎么可能学得会钢琴？真需要弹琴的，外面大把找不到工作的音乐生，直接招来当主播不就行了？
其实，是她没看懂这个商业生态。 老板要的根本不是什么音乐素养。这个生态的核心，是主播必须会聊天、会经营人气。至于那架钢琴，还有那几首速成的曲子，仅仅是个吸引流量的道具而已。 老板算的是一笔极短的现金流快账。他等不了三年五年，他就看这一个月能不能把大哥口袋里的钱掏出来。
大部分普通人，骨子里也是这么短视的。 哪怕做个学习计划，也不敢超过一年，动不动就问，几个月能要什么结果？ 他们去用那种识谱APP，屏幕上显示数字几，手指就跟着按几。这样来得最快，一周就能弹《欢乐颂》。 但我学琴，强迫自己关掉这些数字提示，从认七八个音符开始，像打游戏一样枯燥地练指法。
不仅是弹琴，任何需要建立“盘感”的技能都是如此。就像当年我学打字，用的是最老的智能ABC。 我能把每个字敲哪几个键、数字选几，全部变成潜意识，根本不需要思考。 后来出了各种高级的智能输入法，自动联想，打错了也能猜到你要什么字。业余玩家觉得这种快，但对我这种靠码字吃饭的人来说，智能输入法反而慢。因为它的词频不固定，位置老变，容易打错。
只有用最笨的办法把按键位置刻进肌肉记忆里，你脑子里的东西才能像说话一样自然流淌。 只要打字跟不上大脑的思考，人就会分神，就无法聚焦。这层窗户纸一戳就破，但没几个人愿意下那个笨功夫。
盘子里的资金，其实分得很清。 那些在2700这个中间价位，看着一根阳线就追多、一根阴线就割肉的散户，就像那些看着APP上的数字提示，急匆匆想弹完一首曲子的业余玩家。 他们总想要个极其确定的短期反馈。#ETH 

但你看看大资金在干嘛？ 人家在2626到2750这个大区间里，做着最枯燥、最机械的极限施压。 价格砸到2626附近，有真金白银在那里兜底，把带血的筹码吸走。一旦反抽到2750附近，前期的套牢盘和主力派发的筹码就一起往下盖。 这就叫肌肉记忆。人家只在最边缘的供需区做买卖，把风险降到最低。
大资金根本不跟你谈什么短期的音乐梦想，人家就是在两头收割流动性。 你跑到2700这个没依没靠的中间路段去押注，往上往下都有几十刀的空间。除了被来回搓揉，耗干本金，你拿不到任何优势。
不如把周期拉长一点，别急着今天就要分个胜负。 等价格真冲到了2750附近，多头的钱接不上了，涨不动了。 那些急躁的筹码开始害怕的时候。 咱们再去接手这笔生意。

Last month, Solana’s app revenue surged to $18 million, a nine-month high. But oddly, the coin price fell by 1.47% today. This suggests that the Solana ecosystem is indeed improving, yet its market share is shrinking—everyone in the broader Web3 community is getting more cutthroat.

Why is this news important?
Solana’s revenue spike indicates that its application ecosystem is growing healthily, with both developers and users flocking in. But the drop in the token price reveals a harsh reality: the Web3 pie is limited. The stronger Solana gets, the smaller the slice other chains (such as Aptos, Sui, Tezos) get. This is reminiscent of the 2021 crypto market—when a chain ecosystem explodes, but the token price first falls and then rises. The fundamental reason is that incremental capital can’t keep pace with the ecosystem’s expansion speed, and the fight for market share has entered a white-hot phase.

Impact on the market
In the short term, Solana’s new revenue high may boost confidence in the broader L2 solutions sector, but BTC and ETH are unlikely to surge as a result. That’s because Solana is a competitor to Ethereum— the more it earns, the more pressure Ethereum faces. In the long term, if L2 competition remains this intense, regulators may step in to standardize things. After all, multiple L2s have already been embroiled in data-falsification scandals. Capital flows may shift from chasing pure token price upside toward placing greater emphasis on compliance and more stable projects.

Most crypto traders do not lose money because they lack technical knowledge. They lose because they fail to manage their own minds. The market does not just test your charts—it tests your psychology every single minute.
Here are the four emotional traps that drain portfolios:
 * FOMO (Fear of Missing Out): A coin pumps 40%, green candles flood your feed, and you jump in near the top out of panic. Usually, that is right where early buyers take profit.
 * Greed: Your trade is in profit, but you refuse to close it because you want "just a little more." A quick reversal turns a winning trade into a loss.
 * Fear & Panic: The market dips, fear takes over, and you sell at the bottom just before the price recovers.
 * Impatience: Forcing trades during boring sideways markets instead of waiting for high-probability setups.
To stay profitable long-term, you must replace emotional reactions with clear rules:
 * Trade with a Plan: Define your entry level, target, and exit before you open any position. If the setup does not appear, stay on the sidelines.
 * Never Skip Stop-Loss: A stop-loss is not an admission of defeat; it is your portfolio's seatbelt. Decide your maximum risk per trade—ideally only 1% to 2% of your capital.
 * Master Waiting: In trading, doing nothing is often the smartest position. Cash is also a position. Wait for the market to come to your levels instead of chasing it.
Crypto will always remain volatile, but your decisions do not have to be. Protect your capital first, and the profits will follow naturally.

Sepolia Upgrade Enters Client Readiness Phase｜Validators Must Update Both Layers of Software｜ETH Near 2692—No Front-Running

My stance is to first see whether the testnet runs stably as planned, and only then to discuss the transaction outlook for a mainnet upgrade. The Ethereum Foundation’s Gl Amsterdam testnet announcement released on September 28 clearly states: Sepolia is scheduled to activate on October 6 at 13:53:36 UTC, while the dates for Hoodi and the mainnet are still undecided. This timing applies only to Sepolia; it cannot be written as if the ETH mainnet has already upgraded, nor can an old announcement be treated as a new positive catalyst for today.

What I’m paying special attention to this round is not the slogan of “whether fees will drop,” but execution risk. The official documentation lists the compatible consensus-layer and execution-layer client versions for Sepolia; validators also need to update both the Beacon Node and the Validator Client simultaneously. Since the upgrade includes separating the proposer and builder within the protocol, it also changes the block access list and part of the Gas pricing. Operators using external block-building infrastructure must verify their interfaces. Updating only one layer, or focusing only on the software’s major version while ignoring the release notes, may prevent you from keeping up with the new rules. The foundation also explicitly says that ordinary mainnet ETH holders need to do nothing based on this Sepolia announcement; the link it uses to “migrate coins and activate the upgrade” is something holders should be wary of.

Market transmission should be viewed in two steps: if Sepolia successfully activates and clients coordinate properly, it’s one of the necessary validations for the mainnet scheduling; it can reduce some implementation uncertainty. But passing the testnet does not mean the mainnet date has already been decided, and it does not guarantee that fees, throughput, or the ETH price will immediately show a measurable change. Conversely, if the testnet experiences a chain split, client compatibility issues, or delays, the market may first lower expectations for the upgrade. The foundation includes the relevant specifications in the bug bounty program—this is a risk discovery mechanism, not certification that “there are no vulnerabilities.”

When writing, Binance ETHUSDT is around $2,692. It’s down about 0.14% over 24 hours, with a high of $2,738.51 and a low of $2,667.94. Price is still in the middle of the range, so you can’t say this volatility is caused solely by the testnet event four days later. I see $2,668 as the short-term defensive line, and $2,710 to $2,739 as the upper validation zone. If price breaks below $2,668 and keeps failing to reclaim, the short-term pullback-and-hold assumption is invalidated. If it only pushes above $2,710 and then falls back, that also doesn’t count as confirmation.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t participate—I wouldn’t place a high-leverage bet on the upgrade. I would only consider a low-leverage spot “trend-following” long: enter with at most 1.2% of total funds only if the full hour closes above 2710, the next hour retests 2698 to 2710 while holding, and there are no new client incidents or official delays. At 2728 I’d cut the position in half; from 2738 to 2745 I would gradually close the remaining position in batches. If there is truly strong volume breaking the prior high, I’d keep only a very small tail position and move the stop-loss up. After entry, if there’s a hard stop below 2685, or if within one hour price closes back below 2698 leading to a complete exit, that’s the plan. If 2668 breaks first, the entry plan is cancelled directly. Testnet execution is a matter of technical and security progress—not a reason I must bet on in advance.

Source: Ethereum Foundation Gl Amsterdam Sepolia testnet announcement and EIP-7773 schedule; Binance ETHUSDT public market data. #ETH
The above is only personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

Sepolia升级进入客户端准备期｜验证者须同时更新两层软件｜ETH在2692附近我不抢跑

我的态度是先看测试网是否按计划稳定运行，再谈ETH主网升级的交易预期。以太坊基金会9月28日发布的Glamsterdam测试网公告明确：Sepolia计划在10月6日13:53:36 UTC激活，Hoodi和主网日期仍未决定。这个时间点只对应Sepolia，不能写成ETH主网已经升级，更不能把旧公告当成今天新增的利好。

这轮我特别关注的不是“会不会降费”口号，而是操作执行风险。官方列出了Sepolia兼容的共识层与执行层客户端版本；验证者还需要同时更新Beacon Node与Validator Client。由于升级把提议者与构建者分离纳入协议，也改变区块访问列表和部分Gas计价，使用外部构建基础设施的运营方还要核对接口。只更新一层、或只看软件大版本而忽略发布说明，可能无法跟随新规则。基金会也明确说普通主网ETH持有人无需因这份Sepolia公告做任何操作；借此要求持有人“迁币激活升级”的链接值得警惕。

对市场的传导要分两步看：Sepolia顺利激活与客户端协同，是未来主网排期的必要验证之一，能降低部分实施不确定性；但测试通过不等于主网已经决定日期，也不保证费用、吞吐或ETH价格立刻发生可量化变化。相反，若测试网出现链分叉、客户端兼容问题或延期，市场可能先压低升级预期。基金会把相关规范纳入漏洞赏金计划，是风险发现机制，不是“已经没有漏洞”的认证。

写稿时币安ETHUSDT约2692美元，24小时跌约0.14%，高2738.51、低2667.94。价格仍在区间中部，不能说这点波动由四天后的测试网事件单独造成。我把2668看作短线防守线，2710至2739看作上方验证区；若价格向下破2668并持续收不回，短线承接判断被推翻。若只是冲过2710又退回，亦不算需求确认。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，不做高杠杆押升级。只考虑无杠杆现货顺势试多：完整一小时收上2710，下一小时回踩2698至2710守住，并且没有新的客户端事故或官方延期，才用总资金最多1.2%入场。到2728先减半，2738至2745分批平掉余仓；若真放量突破前高，只留极小尾仓并上移止损。入场后跌破2685硬止损，或一小时收回2698下全部平仓；若先破2668，计划直接取消。测试网执行是技术与安全进度，不是我必须提前下注的理由。
